title: A Wolf for the Veil
author: Ansel Lockridge
blurb: Odile Villalobos, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
